modules.purpose: Next.js route/page/layout and API entry points.
known_issues: Architecture is documented across several route trees rather than one generated route registry.

modules.purpose: CMS persistence/application service for content CRUD, publishing, versions, rollback, audit and file metadata.
depends_on: Vercel Blob for file storage where configured
known_issues: Large service file is a concentration point for future domain decomposition.

modules.purpose: Administrative visual editing environment, Puck integration, content management and configuration editing.
known_issues: Password authentication is intentionally disabled; archived implementation exists in _module-bank/auth-password.
Studio has historically had overlay/z-index and clickability regressions.

modules.purpose: Current public geodesy price/time estimator with configurable Studio coefficients and formula evaluation plus legacy fallback.
known_issues: This is still a migration/legacy adapter rather than the final universal Calculation Core.
Business configuration is partly code/config-file based rather than fully DB-driven.

modules.purpose: Isolated catalog and deterministic execution layer for technical calculators, intended to evolve into the universal calculator product core.
known_issues: Current definitions are code-based; full DB-backed Parameters/Rates/Coefficients/Versions model is not yet implemented.
Current contract does not yet represent the planned public-vs-internal unit-economics split.

modules.purpose: Safe formula validation/evaluation used by the current pricing calculator.
depends_on: formula definitions supplied by calculator config
known_issues: It is not yet the full typed/DB-backed formula AST engine described in the product blueprint.

modules.purpose: PostgreSQL connection boundary and active schema migration model.
known_issues: Database is optional during build when DATABASE_URL is absent; production persistence therefore depends on deployment environment configuration.
Prisma schema is retained as a future/compatibility reference, not active runtime.

modules.purpose: Telegram transport and lead notification integration.
do_not_break: notification failure not becoming lead source of truth
known_issues: Integration should be verified against the dedicated test bot/environment before production changes.

modules.purpose: Admin file metadata and upload boundary, using Vercel Blob integration where configured.
known_issues: Storage behavior depends on deployment environment and should not be assumed available locally without credentials.

critical: app/calculators-lab -> Calculator Lab UI -> app/api/calculators-lab -> lib/calculators-lab/engine -> registry -> definitions
admin file API -> lib/cms + Vercel Blob
risk_points: lib/cms.ts is a large backend concentration point.
lib/calculator.ts is a compatibility bridge containing fallback behavior.
studio/config/calculator.ts is still a configuration source outside the DB-backed CMS model.
Studio UI has complex overlay/state interactions and historically suffered click interception regressions.
Multiple CSS files/overrides increase responsive regression risk.
dependency_map.cycles: No confirmed dependency cycle from the audited architecture; a complete static import graph should be generated before claiming cycle-free status with certainty.

implemented.name: cms_audit_log
implemented.purpose: Audit history of CMS entity changes.

implemented.name: CalculatorInputSpec
implemented.purpose: Dynamic input definition for Lab calculators.

apis.rule: Routes are transport boundaries. Domain logic belongs in lib/ or dedicated domain modules.

routes.note: Dynamic [slug] routes exist under cases/knowledge/services and should be treated as published-content consumers.

runtime_observed: DATABASE_URL is read by migration/build tooling
Vercel Blob may require runtime credentials
environment.security_rule: Never commit real secrets. Use environment configuration and example placeholders only.

deployment.deployment_policy: Documentation-only changes must not trigger a Vercel deployment. Prefer CI/documentation commits without deployment when possible.

tests.coverage_state: Smoke/type/build checks exist; full unit/integration/E2E coverage for the target enterprise calculator architecture is not yet implemented.

security.rbac: not fully implemented; current admin boundary is simpler than planned enterprise RBAC
security.financial_data_visibility: planned separation between public and internal calculator views is not yet a complete persisted permission model

implemented: public calculator with configurable Studio settings
in_development: Calculator Lab as isolated expansion path
deprecated: legacy calculation fallback is compatibility behavior, not target architecture

known_problems: The target enterprise calculator model is substantially ahead of the current persisted data model.
Calculator business configuration is still partly local/config-based rather than fully database-managed.
Public preliminary and internal detailed calculation modes are not yet represented as a complete role-aware product boundary.
Unit economics entities and persistence are planned, not implemented.
Studio and calculator code have accumulated complexity and need continued domain decomposition without breaking current workflows.
Documentation has historically been distributed; this manifest is intended to become the AI entry point.
architecture_decisions: PostgreSQL + SQL migrations are the active persistence model.
Studio is split into app/studio, components/studio and studio runtime/config/types.
Password authentication remains disabled unless explicitly restored from the module bank.
Calculator Lab is isolated from the legacy public calculator while the universal engine is developed.
Calculation logic must remain separate from UI and HTTP transport.
Documentation-only changes must not trigger unnecessary Vercel deployments.

after: run npm run build for code changes
update architecture docs if architecture/state changed
change_rules.rollback: If verification fails, revert to the last known-good checkpoint before unrelated fixes.
change_rules.documentation_only: Do not deploy to Vercel for documentation-only changes.
